camel_example: aliyun cloudfw UpdateFirewallFeature --region cn-hangzhou --Status Enable --FeatureName ApplicationControl
description_en: Enables the application control or web filtering feature for the current Alibaba Cloud account. Only enabling is supported. This feature cannot be enabled for Finance Cloud Free Edition or pay-as-you-go 1.0 instances
description_zh: 开通当前阿里云账号的应用程序管控或Web过滤特性。仅支持开通，不支持关闭。金融云免费版与按量付费1.0实例不支持开通
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw update-firewall-feature --feature-name ApplicationControl --status Enable --api-version 2017-12-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateFirewallFeature

parameters.help_en:
The name of the feature to enable. Valid values:
ApplicationControl: application control
WebFilter: web filtering
parameters.help_zh:
要开通的特性名称。取值：
ApplicationControl：应用程序管控。
WebFilter：Web过滤
parameters.name: feature_name

parameters.help_en: The status of the feature. Only Enable is supported, which enables the feature. Specifying Disable or other values returns an error. This operation is idempotent if the feature is already enabled
parameters.help_zh: 特性状态。取值仅支持Enable，表示开通特性；传入Disable或其他值会返回错误。特性已开通时再次调用具有幂等性
parameters.name: status
